_comment: Byte budgets enforced by scripts/check-release-dist.mjs. Mostly scoped to dist/assets/ (the Vite-built JS/CSS/image graph). Of the native binaries outside Vite's bundler only the voice module has rows (`native`, below); jc303*, rubberband.wasm, sample .wav files and the vendored Pyodide runtime (dist/pyodide/) are not budgeted. See docs/PERFORMANCE_BUDGET.md#bundle-size-budget.
_procedure: To raise a budget: change the value in this file in its own reviewed commit, and state in the commit message what grew and why the growth is justified. Never raise a row to make an unrelated PR go green. The compressed rows are the wire cost and are the ones that matter; the raw rows below them are kept because they also bound what a slow device must parse.

compressed._comment: Brotli-compressed budgets — the actual wire cost. Measured on the build that introduced them and set ~8% above measured, so the rows ratchet: a real improvement should be banked by lowering the number, not left as slack.

native._comment: Raw bytes of the hyphon_native voice module in dist/. Measured on the emcc 6.0.9 -O3 -flto build (docs/wasm/BUILD_NOTES.md#sizes: 137,625 / 124,088 / 27,011 / 14,509) and set ~5% above, ratcheting like the compressed rows. Under emcc 3.1.51 -O1 these were 215,818 / 195,208 / 99,498 / 84,924.
